prompt.label: Generate grounded POC plan and Delivery handoff for {{brief.account}}

brief.problem: Adjusters spend hours reading first-notice-of-loss emails, photos and police reports to classify auto and property claims and decide severity. Simple claims queue behind complex ones and cycle time keeps growing.
brief.timeline: POC live in 10 weeks, pilot with 2 claims teams
brief.success: Auto-classify 60% of new claims and route severity correctly with adjuster sign-off

prompt.label: Generate grounded POC plan and Delivery handoff for {{brief.account}}

brief.problem: Underwriters assemble credit memos by hand from pay stubs, bank statements and bureau reports, then check each loan against policy. Memo preparation delays decisions on small-business loans.
brief.timeline: POC in 8 weeks before the summer lending peak
brief.success: Reduce memo preparation time by 35% and explain every policy check to the underwriter
